messages:
anya: quick design check — experimenting with an inline context preview above the p95 chart. idea is you hover a trace and see the request/route context + sampling badge. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/inline-preview.png
kevin: I like the idea of showing route and sample rate inline. question: does this add noise when you have dense heatmaps?
anya: good point. proposal: only show inline preview on hover OR keyboard focus. default collapsed for dense modes.
marc: Accessibility: make sure the preview is reachable via keyboard and has an aria-live region for the content update. otherwise screen reader users miss the sampling info.
sarah: microcopy: change "sample: 10%" to "Sampling: 1-in-10 requests (10%)" — clearer for non-ML folks. small but helps.
kevin: UX nit: the preview currently sits on top of the sparkline and hides p95 marker. can we float it to the right and add a faint connector line?
anya: yep floating right works. connector line like `border-left: 1px dashed var(--muted)`? I can mock.
marc: Also we should show whether the p95 is computed on sampled data or full. Add a tiny pill: "p95 (sampled)" vs "p95 (full)" so teams know the stat provenance.
sarah: +1 for the pill. color idea: yellow for sampled, green for full. keep contrast for WCAG.
design-bot: Reminder: analytics infra returns sample_rate as a float. UI should display both fraction and percentage per Sarah's copy.
kevin: For the timepicker interaction: if user changes range while preview is open, the preview should persist only if the selected trace still exists in the view. otherwise close it to avoid stale context.
anya: implemented a mock flow where preview closes on range change unless exact id persists. will add animation. any thoughts on the animation duration?
marc: keep it subtle: 120ms fade + 60ms translate. avoids jank for keyboard users. also ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
sarah: accessibility nit: focus order when preview opens — focus should go to the preview container, and Esc should return focus to the chart element. we should document this in AX checklist.
kevin: sampling control placement: current toolbar has a sampling slider. suggestion: move it into the preview for quick per-route override (with an "Apply to route" CTA) — avoids global surprises.
anya: worried about discoverability if we hide slider in preview only. maybe keep global slider and add a smaller per-route inline control in the preview for experimentation.
marc: backend note — per-route overrides will need a debounce and a quick rollback path. Ops asked for audit log entries for any override.
sarah: copy tweak for tooltip: change "p95" hover copy to "95th percentile latency (p95) — higher = slower requests". tiny but reduces jargon.
kevin: heatmap color: current red peaks are too saturated on smaller monitors. propose toning down the max color and adding an outline for hovered bucket to improve contrast.
anya: will update palette and add 2px outline on hover. also adding a legend item that explains sampling and color scale.
marc: final ask: add a small QA checklist to the PR — keyboard navigation, screen reader narration, sampling pill states, timepicker interactions, animation reduced-motion.
anya: thanks — I'll push a prototype and PR with screenshots and the QA checklist. tagging you all once ready :thumbsup:
